storage: Airtight container at room temperature, away from damp, up to about 2 to 3 months once opened (general guidance); no need to refrigerate.
looksLike: Small, pale cream to light-yellow, flat-sided crisp kernels about the size of a lentil, lightly roasted and brittle. Sold as pottukadalai (Tamil), dalia or phutana (north India) and "fried gram" or "roasted Bengal gram" on app listings.
howToPick: Choose pale, dry, evenly roasted kernels that snap cleanly. Avoid dark-burnt, oily, damp or musty-smelling packs, or ones with many broken crumbs.
shelfLife: About 6 months in a sealed pack (general guidance; not taken from a source in this run); turns stale and soft once humid.

usedIn.raw: 4 g per serving (1 tsp); the Low-oil variant uses 8 g
